coptic_restorations.basis: Editor restoration of ⲧⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩ 'poison.' Context 'mingled with the Darkness and the ___' takes the standard pairing darkness/poison as the ancient vocabulary for what the soul has claimed (paired with ⲡⲕⲉⲕⲉ). The ⲧ before the gap is the feminine article and ⲟⲩ following completes ⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩ.

Idiom ⲙⲟⲩϩ ⲛ̄ⲥⲱ⸗ 'be filled with longing for'; the visible -ⲩϩ ⲛⲥⲱⲩ requires ⲙⲟ at the head. The Mother of Life longing after the children = the Lord at the life-bearing register longing after the faculties pressed under the self.
Lycopolitan ⲥ-ⲛⲉⲩ '3sg.f.-see'; ⲥⲁ at end of 3666 + ⲛⲉⲩ at start of 3667 yields the verb 'she sees them in suffering.' Single-letter trace strongly constrained.
ⲣ̄ϩⲏⲃⲉ 'mourn,' paired here with ⲣ̄ⲗⲩⲧⲏ 'grieve.' Visible ϩⲏⲃ requires final ⲉ.
Feminine ordinal ⲧⲧⲙⲁϩⲥⲛⲉⲩ 'the second,' structurally required by the enumeration of three grieving powers (parallel to ⲧⲱⲁⲣⲡ in 3662 and ⲡⲙⲁⲍϣⲁⲙⲧ in 3678). Visible -ϩⲥⲛⲉⲩ confirms.
Preposition ⲛ̄ϩⲏⲧ 'in heart,' formulaic with ⲙⲁⲕϩ̄ 'grieve' (parallel to ϥⲙⲁⲕϩ ⲛϩⲏⲧ in 3670).

ⲧⲉϥⲙⲛⲧⲛⲁⲟ̄ 'his Greatness,' the standard cosmological title paired with ⲙⲛⲧⲣⲣⲟ 'Kingship.' Visible -ⲁⲟ̄ ⲙⲛ ⲧⲉϥⲙⲛⲧⲣⲣⲟ confirms the formula. At the spiritual register: the Lord's Divine Humanity and his rule established in the vessel of the rational.

ⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ completes ⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ 'Light' from the previous line's ⲡⲧⲭⲁⲓ̈ ⲛⲟⲩ- (Vessel of Light). Apparatus signals an additional ~8-character lacuna following which is too weakly constrained to restore (could be a connector like ⲁⲩⲱ ⲡⲣⲏ or similar identification of the sun-ship); only the four-letter completion is securely fillable.
ⲗⲩⲡⲏ 'grief,' the standard Greek loan paired with ϩⲏⲃⲉ 'mourning.' Per editor, the visible trace is ⲛⲗ before the gap and ⲡⲏ after; only ⲩ is missing.
ϣⲏⲣⲉ 'sons,' completing the antecedent of ⲉⲧⲃⲏⲧⲟⲩ ('on account of his ___s'); refers to the Five Sons of First Man.
Middle letter of ϣⲏⲣⲉ 'sons,' between visible ⲏ and ⲉ.

english_restorations.basis: Translates ⲧⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩ 'poison,' the second member of the pair ⲡⲕⲉⲕⲉ ⲙⲛ ⲧⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩ. Spiritually: a particular form of what the soul has claimed, alongside darkness.
Translates ⲙⲟⲩϩ in the idiom ⲙⲟⲩϩ ⲛ̄ⲥⲱ⸗ 'be filled with longing for.'
Translates ⲥⲛⲉⲩ 'she sees,' completed across the line break by gap 2.

The first part of the Coptic gap completes 'Light' (folded into the prior segment's 'Li-/ght'), but an additional ~8-character span follows which is too weakly constrained to translate; honest non-restoration.

restoration_note: The teaching enumerates three registers at which the Lord, going forth from his inmost, is bent in compassion over the soul in mingling: the Mother of Life (life-bearing), the First Man (Divine Humanity), and an unfinished third (the Third Ambassador / the call). Most gaps are tightly constrained: completions of ⲙⲟⲩϩ ⲛ̄ⲥⲱ⸗ (longing), ⲥⲛⲉⲩ (sees), ⲣ̄ϩⲏⲃⲉ (mourns), ⲧⲧⲙⲁϩⲥⲛⲉⲩ (the second), ⲛ̄ϩⲏⲧ (in heart), ⲧⲉϥⲙⲛⲧⲛⲁⲟ̄ (his Greatness), ⲗⲩⲡⲏ (grief), and ϣⲏⲣⲉ (sons) all follow from formulaic pairings in the surrounding Coptic and the cosmological title-system. Gap 0 (ⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩ 'poison') is accepted on the strength of the standard pairing ⲡⲕⲉⲕⲉ ⲙⲛ ⲧⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩ. Gap 7 is split: ⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ securely completes ⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ 'Light' from the prior line's 'Vessel of Li-,' but the trailing ~8-character span has no formula or trace constraint and is left unrestorable on the English side.
